description: a tall woman archmage one with the elements, with long dark brown hair, a flowing ornate robe in deep red, blue and gold with glowing runes, a high collar, golden shoulder ornaments, a golden staff topped with three glowing crystals, red, blue and yellow, held upright in her right hand, the other hand empty, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
